wth.text: Gerrard Capashen's story begins in tragedy, as Phyrexian raiders murder his family and Karn carries the boy to Sidar Kondo, who adopts him.
Years later, after Gerrard loses a wager, he, Rofellos and Mirri join Sisay's Weatherlight crew, with Sisay recruiting them after a knife-throwing contest.
Trouble follows quickly: Starke's poison ruins his adoptive brother Vuel's rite of passage, and when Phyrexians attack Crovax's Estate and Rofellos is killed, Gerrard quits the Weatherlight.
He returns only when Sisay is taken, and the crew eventually meets the Predator over Rath, where Gerrard is knocked overboard.

tmp.text: In Tempest, Gerrard and the heroes of the Skyship Weatherlight set out across stormy Rath to find Volrath's stronghold.
Volrath orders Greven to bring back Gerrard and the Legacy artifacts, and Greven's attack throws Gerrard overboard into the Skyshroud.
There he learns from the Oracle en-Vec that he is the Korvecdal, which wins the crew an alliance with Eladamri's elves and a way into the Stronghold.
In the Dream Halls Gerrard realizes that Volrath is his adoptive brother Vuel, and when he stabs him he later learns it was only a shapeshifter scapegoat.

sth.text: In Stronghold, Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew fight their way through Volrath's Stronghold, battling his creations to rescue their imprisoned comrades.
Gerrard unmasks a dead shapeshifter who wore Volrath's features and calls it "practice", then tells the real Volrath that now he gets to die.
Studying a great globe, he realizes it shows Dominaria, the first sign of what Volrath's masters intend.

exo.text: In Exodus, Gerrard reassures the injured Sisay that her ship is intact, and he bests Greven il-Vec only by sacrificing any semblance of defense.

ulg.text: In Urza's Legacy, Volrath steals many of Gerrard's original artifacts to thwart his destiny, with the Touchstone the first lost, until Gerrard reactivates Karn and takes it from his hand.
In Llanowar, Gerrard uses the Thran Forge and Touchstone to turn an aboroth into dust, showing Tahngarth his connection to the Legacy.
After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, their friends strike a deal to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.

mmq.text: In Mercadian Masques, the Weatherlight crash-lands in Mercadia and Gerrard's crew is entangled in local power struggles, with the magistrate offering him soldiers and mercenaries to recover the ship.
Gerrard trains the Mercadian army and leads it against the Cho-Arrim, but realizing he is on the wrong side he orders hostilities to stop, and he, Orim and the crew are arrested.
Orim condemns him and Gerrard offers no defense, yet Cho-Manno knows he has no choice but to ally with him to free his people.
Gerrard and Sisay would not leave Mercadia without the Weatherlight and its crew, and with the rebels they storm the Subterranean Hangar and reclaim the ship.

inv.text: In Invasion, the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria begins as the crew returns home, and Hanna dies of the Phyrexian plague at Koilos hours before Orim's cure is ready.
At Koilos, Tsabo Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief to control his mind, but he breaks free and, with Karn's help, they kill her.
Crovax, now evincar, takes Gerrard to Phyrexia, where Gerrard pledges loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.
Yawgmoth sets him to fight Urza, and Gerrard beheads him; he then kills Crovax in the Stronghold's throne room.

pls.text: In Planeshift, Ertai taunts Gerrard about the crew's rescue, then teleports him and Squee into the Stronghold, where Crovax kills Squee to prove Yawgmoth can bring back the dead.
Yawgmoth shows Urza his tortured brother Mishra, and Gerrard pledges allegiance to Yawgmoth as well.

apc.text: In Apocalypse, Gerrard and Urza are forced to fight repeatedly in Yawgmoth's arena until Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with his head.
Yawgmoth offers a false Hanna, but Gerrard rejects it, saying "You're not my Hanna!"
He lands in the Stronghold throne room and defeats Crovax, and when Yawgmoth arrives the final battle begins and the Null Moon's mana fails to kill him.
Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, and Gerrard, who accepts his destiny, dies with Urza as the Legacy eradicates Yawgmoth's essence and Karn becomes a planeswalker.

plc.text: In Planar Chaos, Gerrard is living in Benalia, remembering that chasing the Legacy cost the lives of friends and is why he left the Weatherlight.
When Tahngarth tells him something terrible has happened to Sisay, Gerrard decides to return to the Weatherlight, leaving his hourglass pendant, the only part of the Legacy he kept, with Pol Cordel.
Along the way he duels Maraxus and wounds him, and Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, offering to lead Gerrard to Rath.
Gerrard says he has no reason to trust Starke but needs him to reach Rath, and will watch him constantly.
